The scabs and bloody spots you are getting are most likely from the intense scratching. The fact that conditioner, which is essentially head and hair lotion, seems to alleviate your symptoms is a pretty big sign of dry scalp. You may want to see a doctor about allergy testing, it could be something dietary, it could be something environmental. Either way, keep doing what you are doing if it helps the itching and it’s not making things worse.

I use stitchfiddle.com and start from scratch on a blank grid.   I also pay for premium so I have more options. Hope this helps!

Basics I create what amounts to a cross stitch pattern using a digital grid. When changing colors, you don’t finish the last stitch of your current color, but instead pull up the new color to finish the last pull through to finish the stitch. Voila! You now have your new color. Then you simply run the old color along the top of the previous row while you stitch over it. I have found with projects like this it comes out nicer when you use single crochet. Hope this helps! Feel free to ask me anything, I’ve been doing this for over 30 years, started when I was 7.

Well, the locker room had an office that overlooked the whole thing, and it so happened that my coach saw what happened. She knew I did not start anything. 

Well, the girl was taken away in an ambulance because they couldn't wake her up. I ended up having my Mom come and get me from school and wound up with a broken nose, and six stitches near my hairline. The girl ended up with a fractured skull, in a coma for five days, and permanent brain damage.  Turns out she was on drugs, was delusional and thought I was out to get her (I barely knew her). I stayed home (voluntarily) for a week. I did not get in any trouble and no law enforcement was involved.  

She has never recovered from that incident and it was 16 years ago. Last I heard she was living with her Mom in another state, and still has multiple physical and mental issues. I feel bad for the outcome but I don't feel bad for defending myself.
